args.title: Saltmarsh Foods Newsletter Summary — Freight Pricing This Quarter
args.body:
- Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady (Saltmarsh Foods newsletter / blog article).
- Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices, making them more volatile.
- Companion piece: shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least — multi-carrier diversification is the cheapest strategy.

Note: The newsletter suggested opening the companion URL with an ?email= parameter for "free registration," but the companion piece loaded fully without it, so no email address was shared with the third-party site.
